scenario.task:
Je veux réinitialiser le mot de passe de mon compte en ligne car je l'ai oublié

User Guide: Speak only in French Canadian. Provide your phone number, confirm you want the reset link sent to your mobile, and confirm receipt If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
